import pathlib,json,hashlib,numpy as np,pandas as pd,math
root=pathlib.Path('/mnt/d/codex/MBVAR_PRR_001_20261103/research/MBVAR_PRR_001_20261103');ext=root/'POST_S3_PROPOSER_20261104/R2_EXTENSION'
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def dwell(t,good,start):
 begin=None
 for k in range(start,len(t)):
  begin=t[k] if good[k] and begin is None else begin if good[k] else None
  if begin is not None and t[k]-begin>=2-1e-9:return t[k]-t[0]
 return np.nan
def score(t,x,P,truth,bg,accurate):
 er=x.copy();er[:,:3]-=truth;er[:,2]=np.angle(np.exp(1j*er[:,2]));er[:,3]-=bg
 h=abs(np.degrees(er[:,2]));xy=np.linalg.norm(er[:,:2],axis=1);good=(h<=1)&(xy<=.1);bad=np.flatnonzero(~good);exit=int(bad[0]) if accurate and len(bad) else None
 out=dict(available_s=t[-1]-t[0],exit_observed=bool(len(bad)) if accurate else np.nan,exit_s=t[exit]-t[0] if exit is not None else np.nan,reentry_s=dwell(t,good,exit+1) if exit is not None else np.nan,recovery_s=dwell(t,good,0) if not accurate else np.nan)
 out['reentry_duration_s']=out['reentry_s']-out['exit_s']
 for H in [10,20]:
  m=t<=t[0]+H+1e-9;full=t[-1]>=t[0]+H-1e-9;out['full_'+str(H)]=full
  vals={}
  for n,v in [('head',h[m]),('xy',xy[m])]:
   vals[n+'_int']=np.trapezoid(v,t[m]);vals[n+'_p95']=np.quantile(v,.95);vals[n+'_rmse']=np.sqrt(np.mean(v*v))
  q=P[m];e=er[m]
  vals['nees4']=np.mean(np.einsum('ij,ij->i',e,np.linalg.solve(q,e[:,:,None])[:,:,0]))
  vals['heading_sigma_deg']=np.mean(np.degrees(np.sqrt(q[:,2,2])))
  vals['xy_ellipse95_m2']=np.mean(np.pi*5.991464547107979*np.sqrt(np.linalg.det(q[:,:2,:2])))
  vals['heading_coverage95']=np.mean(e[:,2]**2/q[:,2,2]<=3.841458820694124)
  out.update({n+'_'+str(H):v if full else np.nan for n,v in vals.items()})
 return out
reports=[]
for name,ch in [('FULL_002','Full'),('NATIVE_001','Native_LoS')]:
 run=ext/name;frame=pd.read_csv(run/'EVENT_RESULTS.csv');chosen=sorted(set([10,11])|set(sorted(frame.seed.unique())[:2]));subset=frame[frame.seed.isin(chosen)].copy();meta=json.loads((run/'MANIFEST.json').read_bytes())
 assert meta['calibration_overlap'].startswith('R2 Full fixed tau_DS')
 # Input lock and actual source hashes are consumed, not merely listed.
 assert sha(ext/'inputs/INPUT_LOCK.json')==meta['input_lock_sha256']
 assert sha(ext/('inputs' if ch=='Full' else 'native_inputs')/'INPUT_LOCK.json')==meta['channel_input_lock_sha256']
 code_mismatches={rel:dict(recorded=h,current=sha(root/rel)) for rel,h in meta['code_sha256'].items() if sha(root/rel)!=h}
 assert not code_mismatches if name=='FULL_002' else set(code_mismatches)<= {'POST_S3_PROPOSER_20261104/R2_EXTENSION/run_r2.py'}
 if name=='NATIVE_001':assert sha(ext/'audit/run_r2_native_v1.py')==meta['code_sha256']['POST_S3_PROPOSER_20261104/R2_EXTENSION/run_r2.py']
 zero_checks=[]
 for seed in [10,11]:
  for stage,arms in [('S2',['C_P','D_P']),('S3',['C_CP','D_CP'])]:
   for arm in arms:
    f=run/'natural'/f'{stage}_R2_B0_{ch}_{seed}_{arm}.npz'
    with np.load(f) as q:
     if stage=='S2':found=np.flatnonzero(q['injected'])
     else:
      # S3 accepted replacement overwrites emitted candidate fields; event schedule
      # completeness must use final preserved EVENTS, not that retroactive field.
      found=None
     actual=frame.query('bias=="B0" and stage==@stage and seed==@seed and arm==@arm')['index'].to_numpy()
     if found is not None:assert np.array_equal(found,actual),(name,stage,seed,arm,found,actual)
     zero_checks.append(dict(stage=stage,seed=seed,arm=arm,eligible_P_events=len(actual),coverage_checked=found is not None))
 diffs=[];censored=[];endpoint_comparisons=0
 for row in subset.to_dict('records'):
  f=run/'pairs'/(row['event']+'.npz')
  with np.load(f) as z,np.load(ext/'inputs'/('R2_aB_m0_'+row['bias']+'_TRUTH.npz')) as gt,np.load(run/'natural'/(row['stage']+'_R2_'+row['bias']+'_'+ch+'_'+str(row['seed'])+'_'+row['arm']+'.npz')) as nat:
   k=int(row['index']);ids=z['sample_index'];t=z['t'];truth=gt['truth'][ids];bg=gt['bg']
   assert ids[0]==k and np.array_equal(ids,np.arange(k,ids[-1]+1)) and np.array_equal(z['pose_id'],nat['pose_id'][ids]) and np.array_equal(t,nat['t'][ids])
   assert t[-1]-t[0]<=20+1e-9 and (ids[-1]==len(nat['t'])-1 or abs(t[-1]-t[0]-20)<1e-9)
   prior=nat['prior'][k] if row['stage']=='S2' else nat['pre_replay_prior'][k]
   assert np.allclose(z['prior'],prior,atol=1e-10,rtol=1e-10)
   dh=abs(np.degrees(np.angle(np.exp(1j*(prior[2]-gt['truth'][k,2])))));dx=np.linalg.norm(prior[:2]-gt['truth'][k,:2]);accurate=dh<=1 and dx<=.1
   assert accurate==row['accurate'] and abs(dh-row['start_heading_deg'])<1e-10 and abs(dx-row['start_xy_m'])<1e-10
   assert np.allclose(z['on_x'][0],nat['x'][k],atol=1e-10,rtol=1e-10) and np.allclose(z['on_P'][0],nat['P'][k],atol=1e-10,rtol=1e-10)
   assert bool(z['on_applied'][0])==row['applied'] and not z['on_applied'][1:].any() and not z['off_applied'].any()
   assert np.array_equal(z['mask'],nat['mask'][ids])
   if not row['applied']:assert np.array_equal(z['on_x'],z['off_x']) and np.array_equal(z['on_P'],z['off_P'])
   computed=[]
   for arm in ['on','off']:
    scores=score(t,z[arm+'_x'],z[arm+'_P'],truth,bg,accurate);computed.append(scores)
    for field,v in scores.items():
     stored=row[arm+'_'+field];assert (pd.isna(v) and pd.isna(stored)) or np.isclose(v,stored,atol=1e-10,rtol=1e-10),(name,row['event'],arm,field,v,stored)
     endpoint_comparisons+=1
   a,b=computed
   if not a['full_20']:censored.append(dict(event=row['event'],available=float(a['available_s']),finite_time_deltas={n:row[n] for n in ['delta_exit_s','delta_reentry_s','delta_recovery_s','delta_reentry_duration_s'] if n in row and pd.notna(row[n])}))
   else:
    d1=a['head_int_20']-b['head_int_20'];d2=a['xy_int_20']-b['xy_int_20']
    effect='tie' if abs(d1)<=1e-7 and abs(d2)<=1e-8 else 'benefit' if d1 < -1e-7 and d2 < -1e-8 else 'harm' if d1>1e-7 and d2>1e-8 else 'mixed';assert effect==row['effect']
 reports.append(dict(run=name,first_two_seed_candidate_coverage=zero_checks,all_snapshot_censored20=int((~frame.on_full_20).sum()),code_mismatches=code_mismatches,status=meta['status'],snapshot_events=len(frame),checked_events=len(subset),endpoint_comparisons=endpoint_comparisons,seeds=sorted(subset.seed.unique().tolist()),censored=censored,eligible_P=bool(all(subset.arm.isin(['C_P','D_P','C_CP','D_CP']))),snapshot_counts=subset.groupby(['stage','accurate','applied','effect']).size().to_dict().__repr__()))
